messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use with MAO inhibitors within past 14 days"
set: ["use with MAO inhibitors within past 14 days", "use within 14 days after MAO inhibitor", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "use of maoinhibitor in past 14 days", "patients who have taken MAO inhibitor in past 14 days", "use within 7 days before MAO inhibitor", "MAO inhibitor within 5 days before use", "dangerous interaction with MAO inhibitors", "use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) in past 14 days", "dangerous drug interaction with MAO inhibitors", "patients taking MAO inhibitors", "do not take within 5 days before or 14 days after using an MAO inhibitor", "use the remaining half within 28 days", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "14 days in a row", "measurable within first several days"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
